يبتذلان (form VIII)
# يَبْتَذِلَانِ (yabtaḏilāni) /jab.ta.ði.laː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of اِبْتَذَلَ (ibtaḏala)
# يُبْتَذَلَانِ (yubtaḏalāni) /jub.ta.ða.laː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَذَلَ (ibtaḏala)
